## Questions founders ask about Surge

Surge is an AI growth assistant for early-stage founders. You paste your startup's URL once, and Surge builds a reusable startup profile, then turns it into a weekly, multi-platform content plan with platform-native posts for TikTok/Reels, LinkedIn, Reddit, and X.

Surge generates platform-native content for four channels from a single launch update: a TikTok/Reels hook and script, a LinkedIn founder story, a Reddit discussion angle, and an X (Twitter) thread structure.

Paste your product URL once. Surge extracts your positioning, pain points, hooks, and voice into a saved startup profile, then generates a full week of posts laid out as a calendar (for example Mon TikTok, Tue LinkedIn, Thu Reddit, Fri X) that you can edit, regenerate, copy, and save from the dashboard.

Yes. Surge writes TikTok and Reels posts as a hook plus a short-form script tailored to your product, so a founder can record without writing the script from scratch each week.

Yes. Surge includes launch-focused templates such as Launch note, Founder story, Hot take, and Proof post, and spreads one launch update across TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, and X so your launch week is covered on every channel.

Surge is built for solo founders and early-stage teams — including SaaS, DTC, and e-commerce founders — who need a consistent weekly content habit but don't have time to write posts or budget for a marketing agency.

Surge has a free plan with 2 lifetime generations and one startup profile, no credit card required. Paid plans are Starter at $5.99 per month (12 generations per month, all platforms, saved content library) and Pro at $9.99 per month (40 generations per month and full template access).

Surge saves your startup context once and reuses it, generates platform-native posts and a ready-to-manage weekly calendar from proven templates, and lets you edit, save, and reuse content from one dashboard — instead of re-explaining your product and re-prompting from scratch every week.
